description: Nothing to add: ecoinvent 3.12 ships the same elementary exchanges in all four of its system models. Compared release by release from each one's MasterData/ElementaryExchanges.xml -- cutoff 9,850, apos 9,850, consequential 9,850, EN15804 9,850 exchanges -- with the same uuids throughout and every shared record equal field for field, not merely in the fields the adapter keeps. This file exists so that a version nobody has checked and a version checked and found clean do not look alike: the empty list is the finding. Regenerate with tools/compare_ecoinvent_system_models.py. See #100.
